stories.title: Section of Wepre Lane set to return to 30mph and new double yellow lines planned
stories.summary: Two changes to Wepre Lane in Connah’s Quay take effect on 4 September, one covering speed and one covering parking. stories.title: Disposable income in Flintshire rose 7 per cent in 2024, ONS figures show
stories.summary: Flintshire has the third highest disposable household income per head in Wales, according to figures published by the Office for National Statistics. The county recorded £23,426 per head in 2024, behind only Monmouthshire at £28,010 and the Vale of Glamorgan at £26,733. stories.title: Airbus engineers lift more than 365 tonnes in Wales Air Ambulance challenge
stories.summary: A team of Airbus engineers took on the ultimate powerlifting challenge of lifting the equivalent of more than two Airbus A350s in aid of the Wales Air Ambulance. stories.title: Chester Zoo: ‘World-first’ cancer treatment saves python after tumour destroys part of her jaw
stories.summary: A 15-foot python at Chester Zoo has been declared free of cancer after vets adapted a treatment used on human patients for use in a snake.
